title: Cabrillo Hilltop | KEY.co
description_expanded: Designed with elegance and comfort in mind, Cabrillo offers five beautifully appointed bedrooms spread across three levels. Two queen bedrooms on the upper floor showcase custom wallpaper and private balcony access, while the lower level is home to three additional bedrooms, including a luxurious primary suite. Featuring a king-size bed, spa-like en-suite bath, and a private patio, the suite is a serene escape for unwinding after a day of coastal adventures. With exceptional amenities, sophisticated design, and sweeping ocean views at every turn, Cabrillo is the ultimate La Jolla getaway—where every stay feels like a dream. Perched on the hillside of La Jolla, Cabrillo is a breathtaking luxury retreat designed to capture the beauty of the Pacific Ocean. This brand-new, thoughtfully crafted home boasts an open and airy main level, where floor-to-ceiling west-facing windows frame uninterrupted ocean views. The seamless flow between the living and dining areas creates an inviting space for relaxation and connection, while the chef’s kitchen—complete with a breakfast bar—offers both function and style. Step outside to the deck for al fresco dining and sunset barbecues, where the salty breeze and panoramic vistas make every moment unforgettable.
